description: Fork of exp316 (sparse residual_lut, n_sparse=128) replacing the additive per-layer learned pos_emb of dim E=64 with RoPE on (q, k) right before SDPA (half-rotation form, base=10000). qk_joint LUT now receives x directly (no additive position term). v is NOT rotated. Drops 6*512*64=196,608 learned positional params; RoPE buffers are non-persistent. All other hyperparams match exp316 exactly (residual_input_nap=6, residual_tph=2048, residual_sparse_n_outputs=128, out_tph_per_layer heavy-early, NAP/tph for qk/v/out unchanged, noise_eps=0.002, 8000 steps). Tests if the +0.08 bpb RoPE win on MinimalGPT (exp319 vs exp001) transfers to LUT-LM, on top of the sparse residual_lut. Compare: exp316 (sparse + learned pos), exp303 (dense + learned pos), exp319 (vanilla + RoPE).
